newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds remain in the doldrums.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds remain in the doldrums.

text.p: The UK meals and feeds market remained in doldrums on Tuesday with little sign of a pickup in business.
"There just isn't any demand," said one broker.
Brokers said recent UK meat output figures gave the market little hope.
Overall output was down 4.6 percent during 1996 with cattle and calf production 12.7 percent lower and sheep 8.4 percent below 1995 levels.
However, Pig production was up 5.4 percent while poultry was 2.6 percent higher.
Meals and feeds prices were mixed with high protein soymeal ex-mill two stg down to one stg up while stores were unchanged.
All remaining sectors of the market were unchanged.
